path_step: Teacher successfully deletes an existing session.
test_scenario: Verify that a teacher can successfully delete an existing session from a course.
test_case_title: Successful Deletion of a Course Session by Teacher
pre_condition: A teacher is logged in and has access to a course with at least one existing session. The teacher is on the Course Details page, within the 'Sessions' tab.
expected_result: The session is permanently removed from the course's session list, and the system displays the updated session list.
post_condition: The session list is updated, and the deleted session is no longer present.

test_steps.step: Navigate to the 'Sessions' tab on the Course Details Page.
Locate an existing session in the Session List.
Click the 'Delete' button next to the identified session.
Verify that a confirmation prompt appears.
Verify that the system deletes the session.
Verify that the updated session list is displayed and the deleted session is no longer present.

test_data_fields.field_value: Description of session to be deleted
